description: Retry classification beyond Dagster's built-in RetryPolicy — retry on HTTP 429 + 5xx but fail immediately on 400/401/403/404. Classifies raised exceptions against configurable rules (HTTP status codes, exception classes) and re-raises as Dagster RetryRequested (retryable) or Failure (permanent). Wraps a Python callable, shell command, or one-off HTTP call. Configurable backoff + jitter + max attempts.

outputs.description: One asset whose materialization is the retry-wrapped compute. Metadata includes attempts + classification + http_status.

upstream_asset_key.label: Upstream Asset Key
upstream_asset_key.description: Optional. Passed as second positional arg to the compute callable.

compute.label: Compute
compute.description: Compute config: {kind: python|shell|http, ...kind-specific}. python: python='mod:fn'. shell: cmd=[...] or 'cmd string' + timeout_seconds. http: method/url/headers/body/params.

retry_rules.label: Retry Rules
retry_rules.description: Ordered classification rules. First match wins. Kinds: http_status (transient_codes+permanent_codes), exception_class (transient+permanent dotted lists).

llm_fallback.label: LLM Fallback
llm_fallback.description: OPTIONAL. LLM classifies unrule-matched errors as transient/permanent. Shape: {model=gpt-4o-mini, api_key_env_var=OPENAI_API_KEY, timeout_seconds=10}.

rate_limit.label: Rate Limit
rate_limit.description: OPTIONAL. Sliding-window cap on retries. Shape: {max_events=3, window_seconds=60, mode=fail|wait, key=null}. key defaults to asset_name.

circuit_breaker.label: Circuit Breaker
circuit_breaker.description: OPTIONAL. Cross-materialization circuit breaker. Shape: {threshold=5, observation_window_seconds=300, cooldown_seconds=60, key=null}. State persists per Python process.

name: Smart Retry
